title: Carchemish
lead: A fortress city on the upper Euphrates where, in 605 BC, Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon crushed the army of Pharaoh Neco and took over Syria. Isaiah 10:9 names it among the cities Assyria conquered, 2 Chronicles 35:20 names it as Neco's goal, and Jeremiah 46:2 dates the battle to the fourth year of Jehoiakim.
